name: Bögöte (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of three stripes, white, blue and white, charged at the centre of the blue with the municipal arms of Bögöte (a blue shield with a church and trees, within a yellow wreath) below the name BÖGÖTE in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
